description: This is the main HTML source for a web-based database viewer application, including inline CSS styles and JavaScript code for dynamic UI interactions, database and table loading, and data rendering.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and renders it in a table format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the fetched data as an HTML table.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content based on data value type.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses long text or object cell content.
